description.zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If no ID value is available for the public instance, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

description.zh: 本地录像上传任务ID。通过[CreateLocalFileUploadJob](~~363002~~)创建。
description.en: The ID of the local video upload task. The task is created by calling [CreateLocalFileUploadJob](~~363002~~).

title.zh: 查询本地录像上传任务结果
title.en: Query local video upload task result
